extDescription.message: Download the open SoundCloud track or playlist as .m4a with metadata and cover art. Fully local.

popupPlaylist.message: Download the full playlist in this tab

popupNotPlaylist.message: The active tab is not a SoundCloud playlist.

popupPanelError.message: Could not open the side panel.

panelEmpty.message: The queue is empty. Use the "Download M4A" button on SoundCloud or paste a URL in the popup.

err_NETWORK.message: Network error. Check your connection and retry.

err_TIMEOUT.message: The server took too long to respond.

err_HTTP.message: SoundCloud rejected the request. It may be a regional block or an expired link; retry.

err_CLIENT_ID.message: Could not get a valid client_id. Open soundcloud.com and retry, or check it in Options.

err_NOT_FOUND.message: Track or playlist not found (private or deleted?).

err_UNSUPPORTED_URL.message: The URL is not a SoundCloud track or playlist.

err_NO_STREAM.message: This track offers no downloadable stream.

err_DRM.message: This track is only served encrypted (DRM) and cannot be downloaded.

err_PLAYLIST_PARSE.message: The HLS stream has an unexpected format.

err_MUX_INIT.message: ffmpeg.wasm could not start and there is no direct fallback for this track.

err_MUX.message: ffmpeg could not create the M4A file.

warn_mp3.message: ffmpeg.wasm is unavailable: the original MP3 was saved, not an M4A.

warn_raw.message: ffmpeg.wasm is unavailable: the AAC audio was saved without metadata or cover.

warn_preview.message: SoundCloud only offers a preview snippet of this track.

warn_nocover.message: The cover art could not be embedded.

optSubfolderHint.message: Default: SoundCloud. Empty = directly in the Chrome download folder.

optSkipExistingHint.message: Checked against the Chrome download history.

optClientHint.message: The extension obtains it from soundcloud.com and caches it. If downloads fail with client_id errors, forget it so it is renewed.

optClientOverrideHint.message: 32 alphanumeric characters. Empty = automatic. Press Save to apply.

optClientInvalid.message: The client_id must be 32 alphanumeric characters.
